[SWS_PER_00455]
⌈
When ara::per::FileStorage::RecoverFile
is called, Persistency shall try to restore the given file to a consistent state, includ-
ing redundancy. Depending on available information, the file might be removed,
reset to the initial state as described in [SWS_PER_00479], or might contain outdated
content after the operation.
⌋

[SWS_PER_00455]
⌈
When ara::per::FileStorage::RecoverFile is called for
an existing file, Persistency shall try to restore the given file to a consistent
state, including redundancy. Depending on available information, the file might be
removed, reset to the initial state as described in [SWS_PER_00479], or might contain
outdated content after the operation.
⌋
